en: Raihan
Seven badges and a straight face. Nice. I'm Raihan, Hammerlocke's Leader, and the one who's going to beat Leon one day.
text: Șapte insigne și o față serioasă. Frumos. Eu sunt Raihan, Liderul din Hammerlocke, și cel care o să-l învingă pe Leon într-o zi.

en: Here, everything's two at a time. Two Pokémon each, and the weather on my side. Let's see your plan!
text: Aici, totul e câte doi. Câte doi Pokémoni fiecare, iar vremea de partea mea. Să-ți vedem planul!

en: ...That's a plan. Every gym in Galar beaten. Leon's going to like you, and I'm going to hate that.
text: ...Ăsta da plan. Toate arenele din Galar învinse. Lui Leon o să-i placă de tine, iar mie o să-mi displacă asta.

en: The Dragon Badge. Eight of eight. Go on and show the Champion Cup what you're made of.
text: Insigna Dragon. Opt din opt. Du-te și arată-i Cupei Campionilor din ce ești făcut.

en: {player} received the Dragon Badge from Raihan!
text: {player} a primit Insigna Dragon de la Raihan!

en: The Cup's in Wyndon, up north by train from the station by the south gate. I'll see you there.
text: Cupa e în Wyndon, sus la nord, cu trenul din gara de lângă poarta de sud. Ne vedem acolo.

en: Next time it's me and Leon. Don't you dare miss it.
text: Data viitoare suntem eu și Leon. Să nu cumva s-o ratezi.

en: Sordward
So you beat my brother. No matter. The heroes of the legend were never what Galar was told, and Hammerlocke's own vault says so.
The pitch shudders. The stadium's Duraludon rears up to a giant's height, roaring at the stands!
Leon
Not again! {player}, we're with you. Hop, Sonia, positions!
Sordward
Then it falls to me. Let us settle this, Champion!
Sordward
Beaten, both of us... Perhaps the true kings were only ever stories. We will trouble the stadiums no more.
Hop
Every stadium's quiet again! Champion, you were brilliant. Nobody's doing that to Galar's Pokémon again.
Sordward
As I thought. Come back when you are worthy of the sword, Champion.
